name: Blackened Skull
summary: At Agamand Mills, Blackened Skull trophies mark the fight against the Scourge. Deathguard Dillinger in Brill wants them as proof that the Darkeye Bonecasters are being destroyed.

sections.title: Trophy of the Bonecasters
sections.body: Darkeye Bonecasters haunt the Agamand Mills. These skeletal spellcasters turn their necromantic malice against the living and the Forsaken, seeking to secure a forward base for the Lich King's armies in northern Tirisfal. Deathguard Dillinger in Brill asks for their ruined skulls as proof that the Scourge's mystical vanguard is being beaten back.

faq.q: Where do blackened skulls come from?
faq.answer: Blackened skulls come from Darkeye Bonecasters, skeletal spellcasters found in the fields and buildings around Agamand Mills in northern Tirisfal Glades.

faq.q: Why does Deathguard Dillinger want blackened skulls?
faq.answer: Deathguard Dillinger wants blackened skulls and notched ribs as proof that Forsaken defenders are fighting the Scourge. The Forsaken must keep the Lich King's mindless minions from gaining a foothold so close to Brill and the Undercity.
No one in Brill says what blackened the skulls. Deathguard Dillinger wants them as proof that the Darkeye Bonecasters at Agamand Mills are being destroyed.

faq.q: What is the Scourge doing at Agamand Mills?
aliases: why are scourge at the mills
faq.answer: The Scourge is trying to fortify the abandoned Agamand Mills as a forward staging ground for deeper attacks and raids across Tirisfal Glades.

angles.text: As Forsaken, you fight Darkeye Bonecasters to survive and keep your former master from establishing a staging ground on your doorstep.
As a Mage, you know these skulls are the remains of the skeletal spellcasters targeted at Agamand Mills.
